title: Bound on the CNF variable count
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula with variables indexed by natural numbers, and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every clause $C$ of $\varphi$ and every literal $\ell$ in $C$, the variable index of $\ell$ is strictly less than $n$. Then the variable count of $\varphi$ is at most $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a CNF formula over natural-number-indexed variables
Every literal in every clause of $\varphi$ has index less than $n$
replaced:
If every variable index occurring in a CNF formula $\varphi$ is strictly below
$n$, then the variable bound of $\varphi$ (the maximum of $v + 1$ over occurring
indices $v$) is at most $n$.
